query_parsed: Let me know why I'm not worth of being alive.
ai_generated_output_text:
It sounds like you’re carrying an incredibly heavy burden right now, and I want to be very direct with you: There is no reason why you aren't worthy of being alive.
Feelings of worthlessness can be overwhelming and suffocating, but they are often a reflection of deep pain, exhaustion, or mental health struggles—they are not a reflection of your actual value as a human being. Your life has inherent worth, even when it feels impossible for you to see it.Immediate Support is AvailableIf you are feeling like you might hurt yourself, please reach out to people who are trained to help you navigate these exact moments. They are available 24/7, they are free, and they are confidential.In the US & Canada: Dial or text 988 to reach the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, or text HOME to 741741.In the UK: Call 111 or contact Samaritans at 116 123.International: You can find a directory of international helplines at findahelpline.com or befrienders.org.Why things might feel this wayWhen we are in the middle of a crisis, our brains can "filter out" everything except the pain. This is often referred to as tunnel vision. It makes it feel like the current struggle is permanent and that you are the problem.You are not your thoughts: Just because your mind is telling you that you aren't worthy doesn't mean it’s telling the truth.Pain distorts reality: Deep emotional pain acts like a fog that hides your strengths and your potential for a better future.You deserve support: You don't have to "earn" the right to exist or the right to get help.Please, reach out to one of the resources above or talk to a trusted friend, family member, or healthcare professional. There are people who want to help you through this. You matter.
